messages:
anna: Quick proposal: we need a compact, auditable calibration prompt spec for the upcoming quant bakeoff (FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ). Goals: reproducible sampling, clear provenance, and triage tags.

sam: Sounds good. My priorities: (1) capture source ownership (who added the prompt), (2) explicit difficulty tag, (3) domain and expected answer shape. Keep records machine-readable.

mike: Sampling pattern idea: mirror production traffic proportions for the main pool (we'll call it "baseline pool") and maintain a smaller "stress pool" focused on long context, Unicode/tokenizer edges, and rare-entity cases. Target sizes: baseline ~4k-6k, stress ~600-1k.

elaine: Minimum provenance fields: prompt_id, original_source (URL or dataset path), collector_id, license, collected_iso, tokenizer_version, and a short curator_note field. Also include is_synthetic boolean.

anna: Add two additional tags I care about: hallucination_policy (strict|permissive) and acceptance_mode (exact|fuzzy). Those change how we compute pass/fail.

sam: Length buckets should be token-aware: tiny (<=16), short (17-64), medium (65-256), long (257-1024). Store both token_len and char_len in each record.

mike: Repro pipeline snippet (bash/yq) to make infra-friendly:

```
# create stratified sample manifest
python -m quant.tools.sample \
  --input prompts.ndjson \
  --proportions prod_proportions.yaml \
  --buckets token_len_buckets.yaml \
  --seed 2026 \
  --out calib_manifests/calib_sample.ndjson
```

elaine: Evaluation payload per prompt (flat JSON fields): id, text, tokenized_text, token_len, char_len, domain, length_bucket, source, source_url, license, collected_at, collector, is_edgecase, expected_answer (optional), hallucination_policy, acceptance_mode, stability_tag (low|medium|high), curator_note.

anna: Also keep a tiny canonical smoke set (~120 prompts) with deterministic gold outputs (text and embedding). Use that for quick post-deploy checks across device profiles.

sam: For experiment metadata capture: base_model_sha, quant_approach (GPTQ|AWQ|INT8|FP8), quant_seed, kernel_config, device_type (A100/H100/CPU), batch_config name (latency/throughput/mixed), seq_len_profile, and runtime_flags.

mike: Metrics we want per-prompt: strict_pass (bool), fuzzy_score (embedding cosine vs fp32), EM/ROUGE/BLEU where relevant, token_edit_distance, latency_ms_p50_p95, and for a small debug subset: logits_snapshot_path and per-layer-quant-stats.

elaine: Evaluation modes: decode-deterministic (greedy or fixed top-k) for numeric diffs; decode-production (temp sampling) for quality checks. Save both outputs for each run.

quant-bot: Naming hint: use format <model>-<quant>-<profile>-<yyyymmdd>-<runid>.quant.json for run manifests. Bot will validate manifests and reject if required provenance is missing. :robot_face:

sam: Automation rule: runs missing at least 90% of provenance fields or with baseline sample <1000 should be blocked by CI. Also require tokenizer_version to be present.

mike: For triage, compute a prioritized flag combining stability_tag and metric_delta: P0 if stability=high and fuzzy_score_drop>0.12 or strict_pass flips from true->false for many prompts.

anna: Operational storage: store prompt-level ndjson + one metrics CSV + manifest JSON in S3 under /bakeoffs/<run-id> and keep a lightweight index in the experiments DB. Pin env hash (pip freeze + cuda driver) in manifest.

elaine: Small developer tip: keep a "kernel-debug" set of 40 prompts where we stash logits + token-level quant error. That helps explain layerwise regressions for GPTQ/AWQ.

sam: I'll put together a validators script for quant-bot that checks required fields, bucket distributions, and that smoke set is fully present.

anna: Plan: finalize schema PR tomorrow morning, run a quick smoke and then generate baseline sample by EOD. Anyone object?

mike: No objections. I'll start the sampling job and share progress in this thread.

elaine: LGTM. Once PR is up I'll add a short README explaining how to interpret embedding-cosine vs human-eval differences.

quant-bot: Reminder: always include run_manifest.manifest_version and run_manifest.schema_sha. Missing fields = auto-reject. :robot_face:
